parsed.rationale: Both participating records — `AudioEnginePlayerAnalyticsTests.capturesPauseEvent` (line 293) and `AudioEnginePlayerAnalyticsTests.capturesStopEvent` (line 310) — carry `is_test: true` in their context flags. Although the two test methods share a Jaccard similarity of 0.7 and live in the same file (`Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/AudioPlayerAnalyticsTests.swift`), their structural near-duplication is expected: each test exercises a distinct audio lifecycle event (pause vs. stop) and must remain independently named and independently runnable. Merging or abstracting them into a shared helper would obscure which event is under test and could mask regressions in one event path while the other passes.
